verdict.rationale: Pylon documents AI Issue QA rubrics that can be applied at the agent and issue level to check guidelines are followed. Its Monitor & Iterate issue log lets reviewers inspect the outcomes and steps of every AI-handled issue, and fixes can feed back into the agent through runbooks, skills and simulated testing. missing for 10: explicit sampling and numeric scoring of AI conversations, automatic flagging or alerting of failed conversations, a documented closed loop from QA findings to agent changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
